title: LLM Cost Estimate
description: Stops a batch or long prompt running up a surprise API bill: before it runs it estimates input and output tokens and the cost from your own dated price table, shows the worst case when max_tokens is missing, catches a request over the context window, a run many times the last one and a premium model picked for a bulk job, and fixes each in one tap (set max_tokens, switch model), with a Run button that states the cost, and shows the Batch API saving on bulk jobs.
stops: Surprise bill from an LLM batch
